text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex was almost certainly not the deciding factor in choosing him over you. While an all-male panel may reflect broader diversity concerns within the institution, it does not support a claim of sex-based discrimination between two male applicants. Raising gender in this situation will appear unfounded and could damage your professional credibility.

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback. Focus your inquiries entirely on the qualifications: specifically how the panel weighed his ten years of classroom teaching against your five years of deputy principal experience and master's degree in educational leadership.
